description: This file defines the RequestToField class, a MethodOperation implementation for handling the <request-to-field> element in the MiniLang framework. It processes request attributes and maps them to fields, with support for default values and expression expansion.

classes.name: RequestToField
classes.description: Implements the <request-to-field> element, mapping request attributes to fields with optional default values and expression expansion.

classes.description: Factory class for creating RequestToField instances.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes, validating and setting up expression expanders and accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves request attribute, applies default if necessary, and stores in the specified field.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <request-to-field> element with its attributes.
